manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the arms to move the yellow bottle with elongated cylinder body, the bottle with ridges, and the bottle with red screw cap inside the curved rectangular trash can.

Task description: Move the slender yellow bottle on the left, the ridged bottle with a teal-green body, blue cap, and label on the right, and the red screw-top bottle near the front center into the rounded rectangular trash bin on the left side of the table.

Success criteria: All three target bottles enter the left dustbin, with their bodies inside the area bounded by the opening and lowered below table height while remaining within the bin. Merely moving above the opening is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Grasp a straight body section below the shoulder that fits the full pads. Use the upper-middle section of the long yellow bottle, and span multiple ribs on the ribbed bottle where possible. Avoid caps, sloped shoulders, or a single rib that could slip.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected bottle section, and use a side view to confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides before closing, avoiding tipping the bottle based only on image overlap.
- The yellow bottle is near the bin rim, and the ribbed bottle on the right is close to the light-colored container and stand. Consider approaching from the side with more clearance and adjusting the gripper in an open area to avoid brushing objects with the fingers.
- Before moving laterally, lift the bottle bottom clear of the table and obstacles along the route. When crossing the bin rim, leave height clearance for both the bottle bottom and gripper to avoid catching and tipping the slender bottle.
- When moving into the bin, choose a gap away from the rim and existing bottles. Confirm the body is inside the opening with space below before release, lowering the release height where possible to reduce rim impacts, rebounds, or falls outside.
